scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: Detective Morris
dialogues.text: The search starts now. Amara, tell me what you saw. David, keep the original messages and stay with her.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: He was beside the nursery. Ethan's blue sleeve was against his coat.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Did you see his face before the lights failed?

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Yes. Do not ask me that because the doors are locked.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: I am asking so we keep what you saw separate from what we still need to explain.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then write this first. I saw Victor take my son.
